newsitem.title: ITALY: Brindisi '96 cargo traffic up slightly, mail down.
newsitem.headline: Brindisi '96 cargo traffic up slightly, mail down.

text.p: Cargo traffic handled at Bari Palese airport in Italy totalled 1,595 tonnes in 1996, up one percent on the previous year, and mail 1.3 million kg, down 17.9 percent, said its management company Seap.
Passengers were up during the year by 16.9 percent to 835,845, it added.
Seap also manages Brindisi airport, which it said handled 407 tonnes of cargo last year, up 62.8 percent on 1995, 369,042 kg of mail (up 40.7 percent) and 408,050 passengers (up 8.5 percent).
Seap sources said that the growth in cargo traffic has been attributed to increased trade between Brindisi and eastern Europe.
